patterns.note: Sections frequently use full-bleed background colors (off-white, vibrant red, deep green, pink) to delineate content blocks, creating strong visual breaks and a dynamic flow down the page.
The hero section employs an asymmetrical layout with a central product image framed by large, bold text labels ('FROM VIETNAM', 'FOR THE WORLD') positioned to its left and right.
A custom, bold, and slightly condensed sans-serif display font is used prominently for the brand logo and the oversized footer text, giving the brand a distinctive and strong typographic identity.

The site makes bold and confident use of a vibrant, saturated red as a primary accent and background color, especially in the footer and call-to-action sections, creating high contrast and strong brand recognition.

The header, consisting of a narrow pink utility bar and the main white navigation, remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, providing persistent access to navigation.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header by positioning the combined utility bar and main navigation element to remain fixed at the top of the viewport, ensuring it overlays content as the user scrolls.
Achieve strong section differentiation by assigning distinct, full-width background colors to each major content block, using a palette of high-contrast and brand-specific hues.

Create an impactful hero by centering a key product image and flanking it with large, uppercase, and bold text labels that are aligned vertically to the image's sides, rather than directly above or below.

design_tokens.type_scale: Bold, condensed display headings (~4x body) and large, uppercase labels contrast with legible, standard-sized body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on product images and buttons, otherwise sharp corners dominate.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with airy sections like the hero and footer, and tighter grids for product displays.

standout: The site stands out with its confident and almost aggressive use of a vibrant, saturated red, particularly in the full-bleed footer and call-to-action sections, which creates a strong brand presence. The distinctive, custom-drawn logotype and oversized footer text are also key differentiators, giving the brand a unique and memorable visual voice.
